title: Medal of Honor Allied Assault
fleetres_block:
call "%~dp0FLEETRES.BAT"
> "%~dp0main\fleetres.cfg" echo // written by the launcher at every start - do not edit
>>"%~dp0main\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_mode "-1"
>>"%~dp0main\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_customwidth "%FR_W%"
>>"%~dp0main\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_customheight "%FR_H%"
>>"%~dp0main\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_fullscreen "1"
>>"%~dp0main\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_displayRefresh "%FR_HZ%"
_note: MOHAA.exe 1.11 is SafeDisc 2.51.021 (discprotect.py), the same generation as MaxPayne 2.51.020, which DAEMON Tools 3.47's emulation satisfies. The image is a plain 2048-byte ISO (label MOHAA_DISK1); MOHAA ran on .124 in 2026-08 with this ISO mounted (docs/game-render-modes.md). cg_fov is not written: Ritual's fork is unverified for it. r_mode -1 / r_customwidth is the id Tech 3 idiom - verify the rendered size on hardware.
